posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
I have an extra copies of RPG Maker VX Ace and Game Character Hub I can give away. However, I can't simply give it away. I will instead have a contest! The rules are simple, I just want a short story about Cursed Acolyte. It can be about him doing anything, such as a tale of him gathering relics, destroying Siege-Breaker, a fiery evening with Citizen Summer, or anything else you can think of! Just send a PM to me with your story and the one I like the best will get the copy of RPG Maker VX Ace and Game Character Hub. If I am for some reason unable to pick a single favorite story, I will create a public vote for everyone to partake in.

 

Edit: Also important to note that you will need an account on Humble Bundle to redeem them.
